# Prediction intervals that actually cover 90%

> Free conformal prediction intervals calculator. Paste a CSV, pick the column to predict and a coverage level, and get distribution-free prediction intervals with a finite-sample guarantee: split conformal, locally weighted conformal and conformalized quantile regression (CQR), checked on held-out rows. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
